test_create_csn_model: test the create_csn function by building a CSN model with configurable depth and stride parameters
test_csn_forward_pass: test the CSN model forward pass with random input tensors of varying batch sizes and channel counts
test_csn_channel_mismatch: test that the CSN model raises a RuntimeError when input tensor channels do not match the model
test_load_csn_hubconf: test loading a CSN R101 model from the local torch hub configuration file
generate_csn_test_inputs: generate random PyTorch tensors with configurable channel, clip length, and crop size for CSN model testing
